The Senior Director Service Coordination and Long-Term Services and Supports (LTSS) leads strategy, program design, and implementation for all LTSS/HCBS requirements and functions of the Community HealthChoices agreement. Community HealthChoices (CHC) is Pennsylvania's managed long-term services and supports (MLTSS) program serving older adults and individuals with physical disabilities who are enrolled in Medicare and Medicaid. Job Duties:

The individual filling this role must live in Pennsylvania.
Frequent travel required to locations across Pennsylvania including attendance at State meetings.

Master's Degree required: Healthcare, Nursing, Social Work, Public Administration, or related field
The successful candidate has an understanding of long-term care services and supports policies, practices, and regulations.

• Leads strategy and implementation of Geisinger Health Plan’s CHC program, inclusive of Service Coordination and Service Integration.

• Develops and oversees implementation of strategic partnerships on behalf of GHP with LTSS providers, community organizations, advocacy groups, associations, vendors, and others.

• Represents GHP as its CHC leader and LTSS subject matter expert in state (DHS/OLTL) forums (e.g., LTSS Subcommittee).

• Prepares GHP for CHC readiness reviews and other routine audits including those of program standards regarding records retention, which are set forth in federal and state law and regulations.

• Monitors, reviews, and signs off on contract-required reporting as required.

• Develops policies and procedures to ensure effective and efficient delivery of LTSS programs and services, while ensuring a participant-centered approach.

• Conducts regular assessments of program effectiveness and participant experience and implements program improvements.

• Collaborates with the Geisinger Health Plan Leadership team regarding operational issues, staffing, resources, system, and program needs and presents solution action plan for issues.

• Facilitates and participates in GHP committees, task forces, work groups and multidisciplinary teams as needed to operationalize all aspects of the CHC contract.

• Ensures compliance with state and federal regulations and all CHC contractual obligations.

• Develops and manages budgets, in collaboration with other Leadership team members, to ensure that functions and costs unique to CHC are appropriately funded and reflected.

• Keeps abreast of industry trends and innovations, as well as changes in healthcare laws and regulations, and adjusts programs and services accordingly.

Work is typically performed in an office environment. Accountable for satisfying all job specific obligations and complying with all organization policies and procedures. The specific statements in this profile are not intended to be all-inclusive. They represent typical elements considered necessary to successfully perform the job.

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth , we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

title: Product Marketer, T:0
description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 676,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 

About the team

T:0’s mission is to make finance run itself. We are turning accounting into autonomous infrastructure that closes the books, reconciles, and reports continuously, so the people who own the outcome can stop worrying about busy work and start focusing on strategic decisions. We're a small, elite, builder-focused team inside Airwallex, moving at startup speed with a scaled company's infrastructure and distribution behind us.

What you’ll do

You own what we say about T:0 and who we say it to - and then you write it, ship it, and put it in front of customers. This is a production role as much as a thinking role. In a given week you might rewrite the homepage, cut a two-minute product walkthrough, draft the newsletter, build a competitive one-pager for a live deal, and interview three customers. The positioning work matters enormously but it only matters once it exists somewhere a customer can see it. You'll work directly with our CEO, Product teams, Chief of Staff, Growth Marketer, and Founding GTM hire.

This role is based in San Francisco.

Responsibilities:

- Own the ICP and know the customer better than anyone here. Run customer interviews and win/loss conversations continuously, not as a quarterly project. Sit in on sales calls. Turn what you hear into messaging that lands, and tell the product team what you're learning.

- Own positioning and messaging. Build the core narrative - what T:0 is, why it matters, why it's different - and the frameworks that keep the website, sales deck, launches, and content saying the same thing. Then test it: real message testing against real prospects, not internal debate.

- Write the website. You own the copy on every page. Our Growth Marketer owns the page builds, the tests, and the traffic - you own the words.

- Make product content. Product walkthroughs, explainers, demo videos, launch assets. Scrappy and fast in-house is the default; we'll bring in outside help when something genuinely needs production polish. You should be comfortable recording a clean screen walkthrough yourself.

- Run product launches. Build a repeatable launch motion and run it - narrative, assets, internal enablement, timing, and a real read on whether the launch worked.

- Own the blog and SEO content strategy. Decide what we should rank for, write the briefs, and write the pieces that matter. Growth handles technical SEO and distribution.

- Write the T:0 newsletter. Growth grows the list; you make it worth reading.

- Own competitive. Know who we're up against, keep the comparison current, and arm the sales team with something they can actually use on a call.

- Build sales enablement materials. One-pagers, objection handling, competitive battlecards, demo narratives. Our Founding GTM hire runs enablement with the Airwallex sales org - you build what they run.

- Own pricing and packaging. Partner with the CEO and Product on how we price, what's in each tier, and how we explain it.

description:
Falcon is the optimizing just in time (JIT) compiler in Azul Platform Prime. It compiles hot Java bytecode into highly optimized machine code and delivers Java performance that standard JVMs do not reach. Falcon is built on LLVM.

We are looking for a Compiler Performance Engineer to make Falcon generate even faster code. This is not a compiler front end role and not a compiler built from scratch: the compiler exists, runs in production at large enterprises, and your job is to find where the generated code is slower than it should be and fix it in the optimizer and code generator.

You will join a distributed team of compiler experts and work on real workloads with direct, measurable impact on customer performance.

• Implement and improve optimizations in Falcon's middle end and back end: inlining, loop optimizations, vectorization, redundancy elimination, speculative optimizations and their interaction with the runtime

• Improve code generation for x86_64 and AArch64

• Write tests and benchmarks that prove the improvement and protect it from regressions

• Contribute changes upstream to LLVM where it makes sense

What You'll Bring (Experience, Skills)

• 2+ years of professional experience in compilers, JIT compilers or low level performance engineering

• Strong C++ design and coding skills

• Solid understanding of compiler optimization theory: SSA, data flow analysis, loop transformations

• Ability to read assembly and reason about why one instruction sequence is faster than another

Very Nice to Have

• Experience with LLVM IR and LLVM optimization passes, or with another optimizing compiler such as HotSpot C2, Graal, GCC or V8

• Experience with profilers such as perf, VTune or async profiler

• Knowledge of x86_64 and/or AArch64 microarchitecture

• Experience with Java, Scala or Kotlin, or with JVM internals

• MSc or PhD in Computer Science with a compiler or performance focus
